summary: Resolved D04-RP006-001 by removing current suite cardinalities and whole-suite zero-SKIP accounting from normative Design/Tasks. Acceptance now requires successful execution of the named suites with no unexplained failures, explicit execution of both unreadable resolver assertions with zero unreadable-fixture SKIP, Windows ACL restoration/read recovery, retained POSIX/root proof, and actual totals recorded as Apply evidence.
durableFacts: Design and Tasks do not freeze current focused, Domain, or Acceptance suite cardinalities as contract constants.
The Change does not impose whole-suite zero-SKIP accounting.
Both target unreadable-Guidance resolver assertions must execute with zero unreadable-fixture SKIP.
Named Domain and Acceptance suites must succeed with no unexplained failure, and actual totals are Apply evidence.
The ACL helper design and all other 059 Proposal boundaries remain unchanged.
Exact managed OpenSpec 1.10.0 strict validation passed for the Change and all 23 items.
